executive_summary.what_prt_v1_demonstrates: Clean active FFN_UP replacement on Qwen2.5-0.5B and Qwen2.5-3B with preserved quality on tested prompts
executive_summary.what_prt_v1_does_not_do: PRT v1 does not currently beat native llama.cpp speed. The sparse ternary float32 sidecar custom-op path is speed-negative versus native llama.cpp.
executive_summary.what_phase12_shows: Phase 12's ~1.8x speedup was NOT reproduced under the clean Phase 13 llama-cli stack. The old speedup is specific to its binary/measurement setup and is superseded by Phase 13AK.
executive_summary.what_this_means: Future speed work should move to a new architecture path (packed/lower-precision sidecars, native ggml backend, or speculative/batch use case) rather than continuing to tune the current float32 sidecar custom-op path.
executive_summary.v1_status: Quality-validated prototype. NOT a production speed solution.

0_5b.details: 0.5B clean quality with semantic match rate 100%, replacement evidence confirmed, 0 quality degradations

0_5b_post_fix.details: 0.5B post-AVX2-fix validation with clean output, self-contained evidence, 8/8 semantic matches, 0 degradations

dynamic_shape.description: Dynamic model shape support for arbitrary Qwen2.5 configurations (0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B)

sidecar_generation.description: Clean sidecar generation and validation pipeline for both 0.5B and 3B models

pty_argv_runner.description: PTY argv-safe runner for safe CLI invocation with clean JSON output routing

avx2_activation.description: AVX2 compile activation via LLAMA_PRT_AVX2 CMake option, verified with __AVX2__ define check and ymm register disassembly

avx2_indexing_fix.description: AVX2 indexing bug found and fixed — k loop was indexing [k][j] instead of [j][k], causing transposed weight access. Post-fix replacement confirmed.

mmap_sidecar_loading.description: mmap sidecar loading reduces 3B PRT wall time by 46% (4542ms → 0.14ms sidecar load), but generation throughput unchanged

replacement_evidence.description: PRT custom op replacement confirmed via 272 calls (34 layers × 8 batches), 0 callback_overwrites, 0 identity_fallback, 0 native_fallback

phase12_speed_discrepancy_audit.description: Phase 12 speedup (~1.8x) audited — NOT reproduced under current clean llama-cli stack. KV cache ruled out. Binary difference is likely cause. Speedup status: retired.

0_5b.notes: 0.5B PRT is slower than native on generation throughput. mmap benefit not measured on 0.5B.

3b.notes: 3B PRT is ~2.5x slower wall and ~0.41x generation throughput vs native. Consistent across clean and KV cache configurations.

mmap_effect_3b.notes: mmap eliminates sidecar load overhead entirely (OS page cache). Wall improved 46%. Gen tok/s unchanged because kernel is the bottleneck.

warm_harness.finding: Warm harness provides no meaningful wall improvement over mmap alone. mmap already provides available warm behavior via OS page cache. PRT overhead is compute-bound, not I/O-bound.

kernel_layout.finding: AVX2 kernel is optimal for [N][M] layout (row-major). Current implementation is BLAS-equivalent. Strided W access is inherent to row-major layout. No quick gain from kernel optimization.

phase12_speedup_status.kv_cache_effect: NONE — adding --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v f16 changes timing by <2%
phase12_speedup_status.explanation: Phase 12 speedup was specific to llama-prt-posix binary and measurement setup. Not a general property of PRT. Superseded by Phase 13AK.
phase12_speedup_status.usage: Should NOT be used as a current claim. If mentioned, describe as historical/contextual only.

allowed_claims: PRT v1 active path preserves clean generation quality on Qwen2.5-0.5B and Qwen2.5-3B in tested prompt suites
Qwen2.5-3B active PRT passed 8-prompt clean quality validation: 8/8 semantic matches, 0 quality degradations, 36/36 sidecars loaded, AVX2 active, fallback calls 0
mmap sidecar loading reduced 3B PRT wall time substantially by removing sidecar load overhead (4542ms → 0.14ms)
Current PRT v1 float32 sidecar custom-op path is speed-negative versus native llama.cpp on both 0.5B and 3B
Phase 12's ~1.8x speedup was NOT reproduced under current clean llama-cli stack (Phase 13AK)
AVX2 custom op path verified active on Phase 13 stack
forbidden_claims: NO native speedup claim for any model
NO exact equivalence beyond tested prompts
NO claim that Phase 12 speedup still applies
NO claim that latency overhead is solved
NO claim that Phase 12 speedup is falsified (it is simply not reproduced)

1_packed_quantized_sidecars.name: Packed / Lower-Precision Sidecars
1_packed_quantized_sidecars.rationale: float32 sidecars are too memory-heavy (~90MB per layer for 3B). int8/int4/ternary packed representation would reduce memory bandwidth dramatically, potentially changing the speed equation.

2_native_ggml_backend.name: Native ggml/Backend Integration
2_native_ggml_backend.rationale: Current custom-op path cannot beat highly optimized native ggml kernels. Implementing PRT as a real ggml backend op would eliminate custom op dispatch overhead and allow ggml's optimizer to handle fusion/scheduling.

3_speculative_batch_verification.name: Speculative / Batch Verification Use Case
3_speculative_batch_verification.rationale: PRT may be more useful where verification batches amortize memory reads. Revisit speculative decoding integration with PRT as a verification-side approximation.

4_larger_model_research_after_representa.name: Larger Model Research Only After Representation Changes
4_larger_model_research_after_representa.rationale: Do not assume current float32 sidecar path improves with scale. Test larger models only with a new speed-oriented representation.
4_larger_model_research_after_representa.next_phase: 14A or 14B before any larger model work

5_publish_freeze_quality.name: Publish / Freeze Quality Result
5_publish_freeze_quality.rationale: PRT v1 is a validated active replacement/quality prototype, not a production speed path. Consider publishing the quality validation as the primary PRT contribution.

recommended_next_phase.recommended: Phase 13AM: Final archive and tag for Phase 13 branch, then Phase 14A: Packed/Quantized Sidecar Design
recommended_next_phase.reasoning: Current float32 sidecar custom-op path is exhausted as a speed solution. The quality validation is complete. The next productive step is a new architecture path that addresses the memory/compute bottleneck (packed/quantized sidecars or native ggml integration).
recommended_next_phase.do_not_do: Do not continue tuning the current float32 AVX2 custom-op path. Do not run more speed benchmarks on current stack without representation changes.
